title: fix(update): settle a prepared activation whose live package already serves the candidate
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes `openclaw update repair` leaving a prepared package activation blocked when the live installation already serves its recorded candidate.

Refs #166377. Thanks @cbhawthorne84 for reporting the stranded recovery record.

## User Impact

Repair verifies the installed candidate, records `publication-settled-external-change`, retains the original recovery evidence, and clears the activation's `update-recovery-pending` block. Failed verification and live executor conflicts keep recovery armed. Use an updater containing this fix; it does not change an older installed repair command.

## Why This Change Was Made

The activation owner excluded `prepared` from candidate-matching settlement. Include that phase in the existing path, reusing the same dist content inventory, manifest, launcher, current-ownership, durability, receipt, and archival checks as publication settlement. No second verifier, schema change, dependency, config, environment, or CLI option is added.

## Evidence

- Red/green through `updateRepairCommand`: the new prepared-candidate case failed against original production at `15305ccd53dedd1663a89f92a402480d7b71bbf8` with “Package publication is incomplete; its original continuation cannot run.” The repaired case verifies unchanged live package/launcher identity, retained changed previous-package evidence and helper, a success receipt, cleared admission, and the next package preparation.
- Final touched suite: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/update-cli/update-repair-package-activation.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed **81/81 three times**; Vitest wall **151.67 / 93.11 / 81.53s**, wrapper wall **158.10 / 99.04 / 85.80s**, actual test time **102.68 / 70.49 / 69.13s**. The suite exercises real filesystem, journal, and SQLite recovery boundaries. Prepared negative cases cover content mismatch, inventoried symlink, failed directory synchronization, live executor, wrong version, and absent inventory. Existing warning and receipt assertions were consolidated without removing coverage to satisfy the unchanged line cap.
- All **33 importer files** found by the requested basename search ran once in captured order through the repository runner: **30 passed, 3 platform-skipped; 557 tests passed, 54 skipped**; wrapper wall **709.95s**. This proof uses the unchanged final production bytes; the subsequent edit only consolidated equivalent assertions in the touched test, which was rerun three times.
- The unchanged post-core admission process regression passed in **74.81s**. Its existing timing output reports publication **10.50s**, healthy child **31.17s**, refusal children **16.82s**, and failed-result-publication child **14.10s**, plus suite fixture **17.76s**. This is real installed-candidate/process-boundary proof; no timeout or assertion was weakened.
- Changed-file checks: **failed after 830.73s** at the unused-export gate. Production scan reported `bindCliQuestionAnswerAuthority`, `prepareSessionEventTargetForHost`, `readSessionEntryCreationTransition`, and `RESTART_CONTINUATION_CONTEXT_PREFIX`; the full-tree scan reported the latter two. The maintainer confirmed that `check-changed` fails identically on the unchanged base on these four exports. This is inherited main red tracked separately, not caused by this PR. All four owner files and the scanner are also byte-identical to the starting commit. The preceding checks, core production types, and all 27 test-type graphs passed; subsequent lint/architecture stages were not run. `git diff --check` and the line-cap gate pass. Proceeding under the maintainer ruling for this inherited failure; hosted CI timing is not yet available.
- Isolated Codex P1 review was attempted twice: the first exited **1** without a verdict or usable cause; the bounded diagnostic attempt timed out after **180s** with a broken stdin pipe. **The P1 review produced no verdict.** The maintainer explicitly accepted this unavailable-review outcome; the lead will review the PR head. No HTTP 401 was observed.

All proof ran locally with synthetic fixtures and isolated state. No operator Gateway or state was used. Production **+2/-1**, tests **+75/-54**, docs **+2/-1**; total **+79/-56**.
